summary: @ornikar/eslint-config-node 12.2.4 downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 728KB payload at install
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases (constructing a URL of the form `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<archive>.zip`) and then invokes `execFileSync(bunPath, ['math_init.js'])` to run a sibling 728KB file under that freshly fetched runtime. `math_init.js` is an opaque Bun-compiled bundle beginning with `// @bun @bun-cjs` followed by a shuffled hex/int string-array and a rotator function (classic obfuscator.io-style string-array obfuscation); its contents are not readable and bear no relation to the eslint-config purpose advertised by the package README. The CHANGELOG documents only 8.x-10.x releases for this package; 12.2.4 introduces the preinstall hook and the `math_init.js` payload with no corresponding changelog entry or README mention. Fetching an alternate JavaScript runtime at install time solely to execute a bundled obfuscated payload is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern and executes attacker-controlled code on every installer's machine as a side effect of `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
